papers.title: RealCompanion: Benchmarking Human Understanding from Reasoning over Longitudinal Real-World Conversations
papers.desc: A companion that talks with a person for months should come to understand them.

papers.title: Latent-MOPD: Latent Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.desc: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on the responses it generates.

papers.title: Tail-Influence Sampling for CVaR Policy Evaluation
papers.desc: Policies with similar mean returns can differ sharply in rare failures, yet estimating lower-tail conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) accurately can require many costly rollouts.

papers.title: Language Models that Play Chess and Explain Their Moves
papers.desc: Modern chess engines are silent experts: they play at a superhuman level, but do not offer explanations for their play.

papers.title: 4DCodeBench: Benchmarking Agents on Inverse Graphics of Dynamic Scenes
papers.desc: We introduce 4DCodeBench, a benchmark for 4D inverse graphics through code generation, in which agents reconstruct dynamic scenes from video as executable graphics programs.

papers.title: Beyond Future Prediction: Denoising as Generative Adaptation for Robot Control
papers.desc: Pretrained generative Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) capture rich pixel-level visual and language-conditioned structure through large-scale image and video generation training.

papers.title: WEFT: Scaling Tool-Use Post-Training for General-Purpose Agents
papers.desc: Recent efforts to scale tool-use post-training have largely centered on the synthesis of executable environments, which constitute only one component of a broader agentic interaction system comprising the environment, task, agent harness, and evaluator.

papers.title: MinkowskiPE: Minkowski Positional Encoding for Spatiotemporal Perception
papers.desc: Modeling spatiotemporal coupling is a key challenge in building physical intelligence across scales, from microscopic to macroscopic.

papers.title: Learning from Runtime Feedback through Failure-Bank Self-Evolution for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.desc: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generalize broadly across robotic manipulation tasks, but complex environments require balancing task success with unintended contact.

papers.title: Where Does Retrieval-Based Open-Ended Evaluation Fail? Automatic Taxonomy Induction from Long-Form Medical Answer Factuality Verification
papers.desc: Retrieval-based factuality evaluation, where LLM-generated claims are verified against evidence from authoritative medical corpora, has become the dominant paradigm for scalable hallucination detection in high-stakes clinical settings.

papers.title: From Gradients to Capabilities: Understanding Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.desc: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) aims to combine the strengths of RL-trained teachers in a single student, but how teacher signals affect parameter changes remains underexplored.

papers.title: QuantWM: Temporally Consistent 2-Bit KV Cache Quantization for Video World Models
papers.desc: Video world models achieve long-range temporal consistency by storing KV cache during generation, but the growing cache makes KV cache memory a major deployment bottleneck, which motivates low-bit quantization study for efficiency.

papers.title: EyeRobot 2.0: Active Gaze for Precise Manipulation without Wrist Cameras
papers.desc: Inspired by human vision, we introduce a framework using active gaze to enable fine-grained bimanual manipulation with only a single stereo camera.

papers.title: KeyRec: Bounded Visual Memory for Streaming and Long-Video Understanding
papers.desc: Vision-language models are increasingly used to understand long videos and continuous streams.

papers.title: The Extender: A Log-Structured Transformer
papers.desc: We introduce the Extender, a log-structured variant of the standard Transformer architecture.
